context.transcript:
Hey, June.
Can you come to the conference room?
I'd like to get your opinion on some plans.
The architect just dropped them off.
Sure.
I'm really excited about the new office layout.
Right now, we don't have much space for our break room.
Right.
We wanted to change that.
This new full plan offers an open concept that will help everyone collaborate on major projects.
I see.
But do you think we could close off one of the corners of the office?
We could use a private lounge for our breaks.
Hmm.
Let me ask the other committee members for opinions before we do anything else.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，June。
你能到会议室来吗？
我想听听你对一些计划的意见。
建筑师刚刚把它们送过来了。
好的。
我对新的办公室布局感到非常兴奋。
目前，我们的休息室空间不太够。
是吗。
我们想改变一下这个。
这份新的完整方案提供了一个开放式概念，这将帮助每个人在主要项目上协作。
我明白了。
但你觉得我们能不能把办公室的一个角落封闭起来呢？
我们可以用一个私人休息室来休息。
嗯。
在我们做任何事情之前，让我先问一下其他委员会成员的意见。
